# HyperTech and Solar Explorer

> HyperTech develops Solar Explorer, an interactive solar system app for iPhone and iPad.

## Solar Explorer

Solar Explorer lets people pilot a spacecraft through a simulated solar system, explore planets and moons, read planetary facts, browse discovery galleries, and explore an archive of Apollo lunar history.

Current version: 2.1.0
Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/solar-explorer/id6759483367
Product page: https://hyperte.ch/

## Version 2.1 features

- Planetary briefings with planet facts and discovery galleries
- Apollo mission history archive
- Smoother planetary approaches and departures
- Enhanced flight controls and haptic feedback
- Refined navigation panels, minimap, and time controls
- Responsive cockpit layouts for iPhone and iPad screen sizes
